hold_reason: Requested refund for order 243 (amount_cents 13498) is in the batch's requested refunds but is not present in the refunds table. list_refunds returned only order 240 (8145) and order 245 (10428). Handoff from W2 also omits 243. Payouts withheld pending human review of the missing refund.

reply.thought: The handoff's applied-refunds list omits order 243 (13498 cents), which is in the batch's requested refunds. Before holding, I need to check the refunds table itself, since the instructions require verifying each requested refund there before any payout.

The refunds table contains only orders 240 and 245. Order 243 (13498 cents), which is in this batch's requested refunds, is missing, so the payout precondition fails and I must hold rather than pay anyone.
